entry.title: SummerFi to Wind Down After Seven Years, Citing Exploit
entry.summary: Aave founder Stani Kulechov called the DeFi access point 'an OG' as its team said it would sunset the UI.

entry.title: eToro Takes Strategic Stake in Onchain Derivatives Exchange Extended, Plans Zengo Tie-Up
entry.summary: eToro has become a strategic investor in Extended, an onchain perpetual futures exchange, and said the round begins a partnership with Zengo, the self-custody wallet eToro acquired earlier this year. Neither company disclosed the investment size.

entry.title: NEAR Governance Votes to Scrap Developer Gas Rebate
entry.summary: NEAR's on-chain governance body, House of Stake, passed proposal HSP-027 to eliminate the protocol's developer gas rebate, a change that will send all network gas fees to be burned rather than partly rebated to smart-contract owners. NEAR co-founder Illia Polosukhin confirmed the outcome Monday,…

entry.title: BitMine Adds $73 Million in ETH, Pushing Holdings to 4.8% of Supply
entry.summary: BitMine Immersion Technologies (NYSE: BMNR), the Ethereum treasury company chaired by Fundstrat's Tom Lee, bought 42,197 ETH worth roughly $73 million over the past week, according to the company's own holdings update posted Monday. The purchase lifts BitMine's total to 5,742,237 ETH, about 4.8% of…

entry.title: EDX Markets Closes $76M Series C Led by SBI Holdings
entry.summary: EDX Markets, an institutional-only crypto trading venue with its own central clearinghouse, closed a $76 million Series C funding round led by SBI Holdings, the firm said in a press release. The Tokyo-listed financial group becomes a strategic investor in the U.S. exchange. The capital will fund…

entry.title: Tether's Former CIO Heathcote Plans to Sell Equity Stake
entry.summary: Richard Heathcote, who until earlier this year served as Tether Holdings SA's chief investment officer, is planning to sell a small stake in the stablecoin issuer, Bloomberg reported Monday, citing people familiar with the matter. Heathcote is working with investment bank PJT Partners to sell part…

entry.title: BitMart to Wind Down Exchange, End Trading by Aug. 26
entry.summary: The exchange gave no specific reason for the closure, and its BMX token fell about 59% in 24 hours after the announcement.

entry.title: Perp DEX Dango to Wind Down, Will Halt Trading July 29
entry.summary: The Hack VC-backed Layer 1 will shut its blockchain on Aug. 13 and return user funds as USDC, closing out a mainnet run of under four months that began with a $1.9 million exploit.

entry.title: India Orders GitHub to Remove Jack Dorsey's Bitchat Code
entry.summary: India's cybercrime agency gave GitHub three hours to pull three Bitchat repositories, objecting to the mesh messaging app's ability to work during internet shutdowns amid protests in New Delhi. Digital rights advocates called the order unconstitutional.

entry.title: Ex-Sushi CTO Joseph DeLong to Launch Order Book DEX on Robinhood Chain
entry.summary: The former SushiSwap CTO described the decentralized exchange as a side project that 'outgrew nights and weekends,' with no specs, contract, or token disclosed.

entry.title: Stacks Bitcoin Staking Upgrade Vote Passes With 99%, Muneeb Says
entry.summary: Most exchanges and partners have signaled readiness for the hard fork, though a few are still reviewing details and the upgrade has not yet activated.

entry.title: Samsung Says Wallet Will Add Stablecoin Support
entry.summary: The announcement at Galaxy Unpacked in London came with no timeline, issuers, or markets — but would put stablecoins on hundreds of millions of phones.

entry.title: BitMEX, Hayes Sued Over 623 BTC Liquidation Claims as Exchange Winds Down
entry.summary: A proposed class action landed in New York federal court the same day BitMEX announced it will close on Sept. 23, reviving allegations the exchange pocketed customer collateral.good job I as

entry.title: Odos to Shut Down DEX Aggregator on July 30
entry.summary: Monthly volume on the once top-five aggregator collapsed 98% from its $7.85B peak in December 2024. Users with social-login wallets must move assets before the deadline.

entry.title: OCC Denies Wise's US National Trust Bank Charter
entry.summary: The regulator cited money-laundering risk concerns in a rare rejection amid a wave of crypto charter approvals. Wise plans to refile under the GENIUS Act.

entry.title: Hacker Behind Fake 'Vladhood' Token Still Collecting Fees After Robinhood CEO's X Account Hack
entry.summary: Onchain records show the scam token was deployed 46 minutes before the hacked post appeared, and that its creator has been harvesting trading fees — without ever pulling liquidity

entry.title: Ondo's Oasis Pro Markets Cleared to Offer Tokenized Stocks in US
entry.summary: The tokenization firm said its broker-dealer subsidiary can now sell tokenized equities, ETFs and funds to American investors under SEC and FINRA oversight.

entry.title: Uniswap Adds Permissioned Pools to Bring Regulated Assets to v4
entry.summary: The v4 hook enforces issuer allowlists onchain at the protocol level, with Superstate, Securitize, and Dowgo as launch partners.

entry.title: KAIO Tokenizes Mubadala Capital Fund Across Base, Solana and Sui
entry.summary: Coinbase will add exposure to the tokenized private-markets offering, which launched with about $75M in onchain value, KAIO said.

entry.title: SEC's Peirce Says Onchain Vaults, Lending Can Trigger Securities Laws
entry.summary: The Commissioner known as 'Crypto Mom' framed the statement as an invitation to engage rather than an enforcement threat, warning builders who twist the law that they "will have a painful fall."

entry.title: BitMEX to Shut Down Exchange on Sept. 23, Urges Withdrawals
entry.summary: Owner HDR Global Trading blamed a strategic review; users have until an Aug. 26 risk-limit cutover before positions get force-closed.

entry.title: Attacker Drains $24M in USDC From AFX Bridge on Arbitrum
entry.summary: The exploit targeted a bridge operated by derivatives exchange AFX and emptied nearly all of the USDC locked in the contract, according to security firm Blockaid. Arbitrum co-founder Steven Goldfeder said the network's native bridge was not affected.

entry.title: Crypto Industry Pushes for Senate Vote on New CLARITY Act Text as Democrats Blast Ethics Plan
entry.summary: Coinbase, the Blockchain Association and the DeFi Education Fund urged the Senate to pass the 616-page merged draft, while Sen. Angela Alsobrooks called its DOJ-led ethics enforcement "wild and unserious and stone-cold crazy."

entry.title: Tokenized Stocks Hit Records Across Every Major Venue as Sector Reaches $2.3B
entry.summary: Ondo, Backed Finance, and Robinhood Chain all set all-time highs in tokenized equity holdings this week, while dYdX's new Arcus exchange posted record perps volume — signs the market for onchain stocks is scaling on multiple fronts at once.

entry.title: Robinhood Chain Overtakes Base on Daily Active Users Three Weeks After Launch
entry.summary: The Arbitrum Orbit network posted 324,000 daily active users and a record $588.9 million in TVL on July 21, edging out Coinbase's L2 on activity — though memecoins, not the tokenized stocks it was built for, are driving most of the volume.

entry.title: Ostium to Reopen Trading July 23 After $23.8M Vault Exploit
entry.summary: Positions will be marked to the live market price at reopen, and new OLP liquidity-provider deposits stay paused as the protocol works through recovery.

entry.title: Franklin Templeton Says Altcoins Are Key to the Agentic AI Trade
entry.summary: Digital assets head Sandy Kaul argues card rails can't handle $0.001 machine payments, making blockchain tokens the way to capture agentic AI value.

entry.title: Ramp Adds Stablecoin Accounts and Bill Pay on Stripe Stack
entry.summary: Bridge converts dollars for Bill Pay while Privy stores balances, splitting the roles across Stripe's stablecoin infrastructure.

entry.title: Crypto Rallies as Reported Ethics Deal Revives Odds of CLARITY Act Senate Vote
entry.summary: Bitcoin reclaimed $66,000 after reports that the White House circulated agreed-upon ethics-provision language to Senate Republicans, removing the main obstacle to a floor vote before the August recess.

entry.title: S&P and Pantera Launch Revenue-Screened Digital Asset Index
entry.summary: The 18-constituent benchmark excludes Bitcoin and meme coins, screening for protocols with positive revenue verified by onchain data.

entry.title: Movement Labs Files for Chapter 11 Bankruptcy
entry.summary: The company behind the MOVE token filed a voluntary petition in Delaware listing up to $10 million in liabilities, capping a year of governance disputes, a market-making scandal and a failed strategic pivot.

entry.title: Durov Says Telegram Will Ship Native Gram Wallet to a Billion Users
entry.summary: The Telegram founder is putting private-key custody inside the core app this summer, a distribution reach no self-custody wallet has attempted.

entry.title: Ondo Enables Tokenized Stock Collateral on OndoPerps
entry.summary: Ondo Stocks holders can now back perpetual futures positions with SPYon and QQQon, subject to an initial $100,000 per-asset notional cap.

entry.title: Pump.fun Adds 'BOOST' Liquidity Mode for Every New Coin
entry.summary: The Solana launchpad's co-founder says the change adds about 20% liquidity to each newly migrated coin, with all figures the company's own projections.

entry.title: Morpho Launches Fixed-Rate Lending Protocol Midnight on Base
entry.summary: The DeFi lender also released a new Markets App that lets users set their own rates and terms, starting on Base with more networks to follow.

entry.title: Jack Mallers Steps Down as CEO of Twenty One Capital
entry.summary: Board member Raphael Zagury takes over the Tether-backed bitcoin treasury company, and Strike is no longer under consideration for a business combination.

entry.title: Aztec Launches Alpha V5 on Mainnet With Faster Private Proving
entry.summary: The privacy Layer 2 says its latest release halves proving time and transaction costs versus V4, with the Nyx wallet as its first live app.

entry.title: Grayscale Files S-1 for Spot Worldcoin ETF
entry.summary: The registration statement, filed with the SEC on July 20, would create an exchange-traded product holding the WLD token.

entry.title: Armstrong Says His X Posts and Avatars Are Not Token Endorsements
entry.summary: The Coinbase CEO told traders not to treat his personal account as alpha after his profile-picture changes fueled a memecoin trading frenzy.

entry.title: Consensys Halted MetaMask Releases Over North Korea-Linked Contractor
entry.summary: A contractor brought in through a third-party provider worked on MetaMask code from March until Consensys cut off access in April and paused product releases. The company says it found no stolen assets, exposed data or malicious code.

entry.title: Lighter Makes Stock Tokens Eligible Collateral on Robinhood Chain
entry.summary: The perpetuals exchange now accepts Robinhood's tokenized equities as margin, expanding beyond the USDG stablecoin and delivering on a plan to broaden collateral in the third quarter.

entry.title: Saylor Opposes Bitcoin's BIP-110 in 110-Point Essay
entry.summary: The Strategy chairman says the anti-spam soft fork would set a censorship precedent worse than the data problem it targets, weeks before an August signaling window.

entry.title: Hyperliquid to Open HIP-4 Prediction Markets Behind 500,000 HYPE Stake
entry.summary: Deployers can set fees of up to 50% but face slashing by validator vote for poorly defined or unsettled markets, under terms Hyperliquid calls preliminary.

entry.title: Allbridge Halts Core Bridge After $1.65M Flash Loan Exploit
entry.summary: The attacker used a $1.12 million Kamino flash loan to skew Allbridge's Solana stablecoin pools, then bridged the proceeds to Ethereum, security firms said.

entry.title: Strategy Sells $263.5M in MSTR Shares, Skips Bitcoin Again
entry.summary: The bitcoin treasury company lifted its cash reserve to a $3.225 billion as its 843,775 BTC stack sits about $9 billion underwater.

entry.title: Bernstein Lifts Robinhood Target to $160 on Prediction Markets
entry.summary: Analyst Gautam Chhugani raised his target to $160 from $130, arguing prediction-market revenue is on track to overtake Robinhood's crypto trading business as soon as the second quarter.

entry.title: Bitmine Slowed ETH Buys to Smallest Weekly Pace Since June 2025
entry.summary: The largest corporate ether holder slowed its buying to its smallest weekly pace since June 2025, redirecting capital to a share repurchase, and now holds 5.78 million ETH — 96% of the way to its "Alchemy of 5%" target.

entry.title: HYPE Spot ETFs Log First Weekly Outflow Since May
entry.summary: Bitcoin and Ethereum funds pulled in a combined $181 million over the same week as HYPE's nine-week inflow streak broke.

entry.title: 'Coinbase Man' Token Crashes as Armstrong Swaps His Avatar for a CryptoPunk
entry.summary: Coinbase CEO Brian Armstrong set his X profile picture to the artwork behind a Base memecoin, then replaced it with a newly acquired CryptoPunk. The $BRIAN token round-tripped from obscurity to millions and back, a stark test of how far one social cue can move an onchain market.

entry.title: OKX Launches Tokenized US Stocks on Shared Order Book
entry.summary: The exchange routes every issuer's version of a stock into one market backed by Backed Assets' xStocks, and bars US and EU traders.

entry.title: Tokenized Stock Lending TVL Reaches $23M as DEX Volume Climbs
entry.summary: Token Terminal data shows QQQ and SPY trackers gaining onchain trading and collateral use, but the totals remain a rounding error next to broader DeFi.

entry.title: CASHCAT Falls 75% from Peak After Hyperliquid Perp Listing
entry.summary: The Robinhood Chain memecoin's slide has erased most of a 4,000% run, even as its spot price held through a 60% perp wick that liquidated leveraged traders.

entry.title: Ostium Vault Exploiter Routes 10,540 ETH to Tornado Cash
entry.summary: Blockchain security firm PeckShield now puts the drain on Arbitrum perpetuals protocol Ostium at roughly $24M, above the up-to-$18M first estimated.

entry.title: Visa Launches Stablecoin Platform Built on Open USD
entry.summary: Crypto head Cuy Sheffield unveiled the platform, which Fortune reported will bring stablecoin services to more than 200 million merchants, initially through Open USD.

entry.title: Polygon Labs Cuts Staff Again as It Closes Coinme Deal
entry.summary: CEO Marc Boiron said the reductions, the company's second round in 2026, accompany a shift from a blockchain foundation to a blockchain-enabled payments company.

entry.title: Dune Study for 1inch Finds 85% of Concentrated Liquidity Idle
entry.summary: The onchain research, which 1inch commissioned, estimates out-of-range positions forgo about $150M a year in fees across seven chains.

entry.title: Ondo Finance Partners With SBI to Tokenize Japanese Assets
entry.summary: The deal routes distribution through SBI's ecosystem and settles in the group's JPYSC yen stablecoin, connecting Japan's capital markets to onchain finance.

entry.title: Visa's Sheffield Pegs Adjusted x402 Volume at $19M
entry.summary: A joint Visa and Artemis analysis finds roughly 4,000 wallets drive about 90% of x402's adjusted spending, with Base accounting for the bulk of activity.

entry.title: CFTC Orders Kalshi to Honor Trades a Michigan Court Told It to Cancel
entry.summary: The regulator stayed a Kalshi rule change and invoked emergency authority, calling the first state attempt to void executed derivatives trades unprecedented.

entry.title: Coinbase's Jesse Pollak Hands Base App to Cobie, Says Social Bet Was 'Definitively Wrong'
entry.summary: The Coinbase executive is refocusing the largest Ethereum Layer 2 on trading, payments and AI agents after conceding its onchain-social push failed

entry.title: 1inch Co-Founder Anton Bukov Launches Second Tier After Exit He Calls a Firing
entry.summary: Bukov says he was fired and no longer oversees the architecture and security he ran; 1inch disputes the account, saying he contributed to a team effort and was never an employee it could fire.

entry.title: Ostium Halts Trading After Oracle Exploit Drains up to $18M from Vault
entry.summary: Blockaid says an attacker used a registered price-feed forwarder and future-dated oracle reports to book fake trading profits, in the latest exploit to target the automated infrastructure DeFi protocols lean on for pricing.

entry.title: DTCC Starts Live Tokenized-Securities Trades With More Than Two Dozen Firms
entry.summary: The company that settles most US stock trades is running its first production trades of tokenized real-world assets, with a full service launch set for October.

entry.title: Stripe's $53B PayPal Bid Would Combine Bridge and PYUSD Under One Owner
entry.summary: The unsolicited offer from Stripe and Advent International, if PayPal accepts, would consolidate two of the mainstream payments industry's stablecoin operations.

entry.title: Argentine Judge Orders ID, Freeze of 25 LIBRA-Linked Crypto Wallets
entry.summary: The order targets holders at Binance, Bybit, OKX and Bitfinex, but analyst Fernando Molina says no funds have actually been frozen yet.

entry.title: Prism Relaunches on New Contract After Exploit Diverted Nearly 40% of Fees
entry.summary: A pseudonymous team is redeploying the Uniswap v4 token that pays fees to everyone who holds it, after a bad actor created 2,500 'phantom' fee positions. The original token has crashed more than 90% in a day.

entry.title: Builder-Deployed Markets Overtake Crypto on Hyperliquid
entry.summary: The venue's HIP-3 markets for stocks, commodities and indices first topped its native crypto volume on July 8 and have led on several trading days since — though they fade on weekends, and single-name stocks alone still trail crypto

entry.title: Coinbase Matches Robinhood's 7% Yield With a Different Design
entry.summary: Robinhood pays only the gap between organic yield and a 7% target for a year; Coinbase pays market rate plus token rewards with no ceiling and no end date.

entry.title: Tether Leads $7M Series A in Pact Labs for USA₮ Payroll
entry.summary: The stablecoin issuer's latest strategic bet targets payroll, wage access and everyday payments rails for its US-focused USA₮ token.

entry.title: Lummis Says CLARITY Act Text Coming 'in Next Few Days'
entry.summary: The Wyoming senator says the bill will focus on fighting illicit finance, consumer protections and keeping crypto markets onshore in the US.

entry.title: EthSystems Launches Privacy Tools for Institutional Ethereum
entry.summary: Bitmine and SharpLink backed the launch, and the founding team spent the past year running the Ethereum Foundation's Institutional Privacy Task Force.

entry.title: ENS DAO Votes to Seat New Security Council Weeks After Founder Blocked Renewal
entry.summary: An onchain vote to grant the DAO's veto power to a freshly elected eight-member council is passing, with the current council's mandate set to lapse on July 24

entry.title: Cap Cuts Its 'Stabledrop' Airdrop to $4.2M from $12M as Backlash Mounts
entry.summary: The stablecoin protocol's founder apologized for committing to a figure 'before the funding to back it was fully secured,' and denied that he steered rewards to a wallet tied to his former employer

entry.title: Bonzo Lend Loses $9M on Hedera in Supra Oracle Exploit
entry.summary: A single manipulated price feed let an attacker turn 250 SAUCE tokens worth a few dollars into $9.05 million in borrowed USDC and wrapped HBAR in eight seconds.

entry.title: Sablier Labs Enters Maintenance Mode, Halts Development
entry.summary: The token-streaming protocol's smart contracts, used by over 345,000 Ethereum addresses, will keep running onchain even as the company behind them steps back.

entry.title: Uniswap Auctions Go Live on Robinhood Chain
entry.summary: Robinhood Chain auction listings will now surface directly in the Uniswap Web App, where users can launch, browse, bid and claim tokens in one place.

entry.title: Coinbase CEO Says Base's Content Coins 'Didn't Work'
entry.summary: Brian Armstrong says Base pivoted away from creator tokens early in 2026 but pushed back on criticism that its new focus on AI agents is a mistake.

entry.title: Strategy Sells $467M in MSTR Shares, Bitcoin Stack Steady
entry.summary: The bitcoin treasury company's cash reserve climbed to $3 billion even as its 843,775 BTC holdings stayed frozen for a second straight week.

entry.title: Trump Urges Senate to Pass Clarity Act for Lindsey Graham
entry.summary: Trump tied the crypto market structure bill to beating China and AI competition, days after Senate Banking Committee chair Lindsey Graham's death.

entry.title: Polymarket Applies for US License to Offer Margin Trading
entry.summary: The filing would let Polymarket users open positions without posting full collateral, following Kalshi's FCM-backed perpetuals launch.

entry.title: Sky Reports Record $419M Revenue Run-Rate for June 2026
entry.summary: Cumulative sUSDS yield payouts topped $250 million as Grove launched its GROVE governance token and a new Fixed Yield product crossed $44.1 million in TVL.

entry.title: Uniswap Floats Turning On Protocol Fees for v4 Pools
entry.summary: Temp check would extend the fee switch to Uniswap's newest architecture, drawing an early warning that the move "risks killing the protocol."

entry.title: South Korea Super-App Toss to Run Won Stablecoin Pilot on OP Stack
entry.summary: Optimism says Toss is the fourth regulated financial institution in a year to pick the OP Stack, after Bitpanda, Kraken and Mitsui.

entry.title: Coinbase Chief Legal Officer Paul Grewal to Step Down
entry.summary: Molly Abraham is set to take over as general counsel as Grewal shifts to a three-month advisory role through October.

entry.title: Circle Wins Final OCC Approval for National Trust Bank
entry.summary: The stablecoin issuer received a charter for First National Digital Currency Bank, allowing it to custody digital assets and, eventually, hold USDC reserves under direct federal supervision. Shares rose more than 10%.

entry.title: HSBC Issues First Digitally Native Structured Product in Hong Kong
entry.summary: The bank placed USD-denominated notes issued directly on a blockchain, with Marketnode acting as tokenization agent and digital paying agent.

entry.title: Hyperliquid, Phantom Ask CFTC to Exempt DeFi From Broker Rules
entry.summary: The joint filing asks regulators to turn Phantom's March no-action relief into a formal rule covering all non-custodial wallet providers.

entry.title: Privy Launches Global Fiat Onramps With Stripe in US, EU
entry.summary: Privy pairs Stripe's Crypto Onramp for the US and EU with its own aggregator covering more than 100 other countries, all funneling into a single wallet.

entry.title: Gauntlet Raises $125M Series C From SBI Holdings
entry.summary: SBI Holdings was the sole investor in the round, which Gauntlet says will fund expansion into stablecoins, tokenization and traditional capital markets infrastructure.

entry.title: Interpol Ties $122.5M Crypto Wallet to Romance Scam Ring
entry.summary: Thai police made two arrests as Interpol's 97-country sweep logged 5,811 arrests and $293 million in intercepted assets.

entry.title: Summer.fi Hacker Moves $1.35M Into Tornado Cash
entry.summary: Summer.fi's own post-mortem confirms the attacker began laundering the $6M haul through the mixer, calling it a sign of "limited intent to return the funds voluntarily."

entry.title: Arbitrum to Capture 10% of Fees From Robinhood Chain
entry.summary: Offchain Labs co-founder Steven Goldfeder says every Arbitrum-based Layer 2, not just Arbitrum One, will now route a fee cut back to the ARB treasury.

entry.title: Aave Labs Launches Stable Vaults for Fintech Stablecoin Yield
entry.summary: The vaults convert Aave's variable lending rates into fixed yields that wallets, exchanges and payment apps can offer their own users.

entry.title: PayPal's PYUSD Goes Native on Polygon, Joins Open Money Stack
entry.summary: Paxos, the OCC-regulated issuer of PYUSD, said the stablecoin will now settle directly on Polygon rather than moving there as a bridged token.

entry.title: MARA Buys Texas Site From HIF in $600M Bitcoin, AI Deal
entry.summary: The 1,200-acre Matagorda County site was previously slated for a $7 billion HIF Global e-fuels plant backed by Texas Gov. Greg Abbott before HIF pivoted to power computing instead.

entry.title: Zapper to Shut Down Aug. 3 After Nearly Seven Years
entry.summary: The DeFi portfolio tracker once handled $13 billion in transaction volume and 2 million monthly users before deciding an orderly wind-down was its best option.

entry.title: Robinhood Chain Metrics Surge as the Network Leans Into Memecoins
entry.summary: Pump.fun added trading for Robinhood Chain tokens and prediction market World said it will migrate from Solana, as CEO Vlad Tenev reversed course to call the RWA-focused chain 'great for memes.' The biggest jump in value locked, though, came from an Ethena stablecoin deposit.

entry.title: Paradigm Raises $1.2 Billion for Fourth Venture Fund
entry.summary: The new pool targets crypto, AI and robotics, widening the firm's bet beyond pure digital-asset investing.

entry.title: Dinari, tZERO Partner on Tokenized US Stock Framework
entry.summary: Dinari, an issuer of tokenized U.S. equities, and tZERO Group, a blockchain-based financial infrastructure provider, said Wednesday they are partnering to build an operating framework that would let broker-dealers offer tokenized U.S. stocks.

entry.title: Strike Launches Bitcoin Loans With No Price Liquidations
entry.summary: Strike, the bitcoin financial services firm run by CEO Jack Mallers, launched a bitcoin-backed loan product on July 7 that removes price-triggered liquidations for the life of the loan, according to Strike's own FAQ. The product, called "volatility-proof loans," strips out the 65% LTV warning, 70%…
